limitations: own Java driver via common Groovy helper and Groovy/Kotlin build wrappers; no unchanged KGP build integration
closed explicit runtime profile including same-version reflect override; no default Maven resolution or arbitrary compiler versions
synchronous in-process BTA only; no daemon, parallel, incremental no-op or cache-hit reuse proof
pre/post content checks cannot exclude transient change-and-restore or prove all writers are excluded
additional evaluation measures the owned Gradle provider and concrete-list selection, not all private compiler suppliers
published snapshot evidence contains size/digest/class count only; saved bytes remain in the disposable native project
configuration snapshot descriptors bind staged paths to sealed entries; snapshot content is guarded only by preflight/postflight checks
binding reuse, context mismatch and parameter path mismatch are rejected only in record mutations; a path mismatch aborts the native driver instead of recording a rejection
published private IC cache keeps entry count, total size, inventory digest and the shrunk snapshot entry only
